name: moe_wgs_ft32_v1
hypothesis: Halving the WGS output-token tile may reduce the 96-register accumulator footprint and improve the memory-heavy H200 kernel, especially for skewed high-batch jobs.
result: All six output comparisons passed the task reference. The 32-token tile regressed 3-5% at batch 32, 5-10% at batch 128, and 12-18% at batch 256. Do not promote.
change: Set OKC_FT_T=32 for the WGS main kernel; all routing, dequantization, and epilogue math unchanged.
